source.title: The Straight Story
source.author: David Lynch
source.citation: The Straight Story (1999), dir. David Lynch

title: Two hundred and forty miles on a lawnmower
situation: Alvin Straight, seventy-three, lives in Iowa and learns that his estranged brother has had a stroke two hundred and forty miles away. He cannot drive, and he will not fly.
wise_response: He buys a riding lawnmower and drives it for six weeks, camping along the way, to reach his brother and make peace.
why_it_worked: The slowness was the point. It gave him time to arrive as someone ready to reconcile, and it asked nothing of his brother except presence.
tempting_wrong_answer: Send a message, or wait for the brother to reach out first.
translation_notes: Own summary of the film's moral arc. No script or dialogue reproduced.

title: The cleaner who noticed the trees
situation: Hirayama cleans public toilets in Tokyo. He lives alone in a small flat, with cassette tapes and paperback books.
wise_response: He does the work carefully, photographs the trees on his lunch break, and keeps his life small enough to attend to.
why_it_worked: He is not waiting for a bigger life. Attention rather than ambition is what makes the days good.
tempting_wrong_answer: Treat the job as beneath him and spend the days resenting it.
translation_notes: Own summary of the film's moral arc. No script or dialogue reproduced.

source.title: A Man Escaped
source.author: Robert Bresson
source.citation: A Man Escaped (1956), dir. Robert Bresson

title: The escape that was planned for months
situation: A Resistance fighter is imprisoned by the Gestapo in Lyon and awaits execution.
wise_response: He studies the cell, the guards' routines and the hinges for months, makes tools from what is at hand, and escapes on the night he judges right, taking a young prisoner with him.
why_it_worked: He never mistook hope for a plan. Every step was tested before it was used, and he waited until the odds were his.
tempting_wrong_answer: Rush an escape while the guards are alert, or trust a stranger with the plan.
translation_notes: Own summary of the film's moral arc. No script or dialogue reproduced.

source.title: Dead Man Walking
source.author: Tim Robbins
source.citation: Dead Man Walking (1995), dir. Tim Robbins

title: The nun who stayed
situation: A nun is asked to counsel a man on death row who has been convicted of murder and denies the worst of it.
wise_response: She visits him for years, listens without excusing him, and stays through the execution, while also sitting with the victims' families.
why_it_worked: She separated the person from the act without pretending the act was smaller than it was. Mercy held because it was honest.
tempting_wrong_answer: Either condemn him and stay away, or become his advocate and forget the victims.
translation_notes: Own summary of the film's moral arc. No script or dialogue reproduced.

source.title: The Quiet Girl
source.author: Colm Bairead
source.citation: The Quiet Girl (2022), dir. Colm Bairead

title: A summer of ordinary care
situation: A neglected nine-year-old is sent to spend the summer with distant relatives on a farm while her mother has another child.
wise_response: The couple feed her, teach her chores, and let her be useful without making her earn affection. When she has to leave, she runs after the car.
why_it_worked: They gave her ordinary care — food, work, attention — instead of pity. Being treated as capable is what let her trust them.
tempting_wrong_answer: Shower her with treats, or keep her at arm's length because she is only temporary.
translation_notes: Own summary of the film's moral arc. No script or dialogue reproduced.

title: Notes in a lunchbox
situation: A Mumbai office worker's lunch is delivered by mistake to a stranger, an aging accountant. She writes a note the next day.
wise_response: They exchange notes in the lunchbox — small, honest, increasingly personal — without meeting, and each begins to change how he lives.
why_it_worked: The exchange was low-stakes enough to be honest, and reciprocal: each gave something and each received something, so neither became the other's project.
tempting_wrong_answer: Meet immediately and turn it into a romance, or stop writing once it got real.
translation_notes: Own summary of the film's moral arc. No script or dialogue reproduced.
